explanation: This test only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock), nor does it check that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test misses assertions on the order of operations and the locking of FX rate, and it does not test the approval workflow for large top-ups.
missingAssertions: Assert FX rate is locked at the moment top-up is initiated
Assert destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Assert top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the FX rate is not locked at initiation and fluctuates during processing would not be caught. Also, a bug where the funding source is debited before the wallet is credited would not be detected. Additionally, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up process including FX rate locking, credit-before-debit, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate remains constant during processing
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Confirm wallet balance increases by SGD 500
Verify that second business owner approval is requested before settlement
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Confirm wallet balance increases by SGD 15,000
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; wallet balance increases accordingly
